planets.name: TIC 393818343 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 393818343 with a 16.2-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TIC 393818343 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 393818343. Its orbit and size follow Sgro et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
